stemMd: A molecule has the group –CHO at the end of a carbon chain. To which class does it belong?
explanationMd: The terminal –CHO group contains a carbonyl carbon bonded to hydrogen, the defining feature of an aldehyde. A ketone has a carbonyl too, but its carbonyl carbon is bonded to two carbon groups. Check the atoms attached to the carbonyl carbon.

distractorRationale.e: A ketone carbonyl is bonded to two carbon groups.
distractorRationale.b: An ether has oxygen linking two carbon groups without a carbonyl.
distractorRationale.a: Alkanes contain only carbon and hydrogen with single bonds.
